This '''[[B2 grapple droid/Legends|grapple droid]]''' was present in the [[Battle of Antamont]]. It detected a [[Lone battle droid|deserter B1 battle droid]] and tried to convince it to return to the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]]. When the B1 droid refused, the grapple droid attacked, but ended up falling apart, remaining barely functioning for a short while. The grapple droid was afraid of going off-line, but the B1 eased its fears, and showed compassion by staying with it until the grapple droid eventually [[Death/Legends|shut down permanently]].<ref name="pathways" />
